test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks will create a repetitive pattern.

c_bca_c_bc_b
solution:
Let's check each option:

 
• c**a**b - ca**b - **c**c**b - c**c**b. - No repetitive pattern
 
• cab - cab - cbb - ccb. - No repetitive pattern
 
• cab - cab - c**a**b - ccb. - No repetitive pattern
 
• cab - cab - c**a**b - c**a**b. - The term "cab" is repeated

Hence, **"abaa"** is the correct answer.
